## About

Sohail Gidwani is an AI/ML engineer and full-stack developer currently pursuing a Master of Science in Computer Science at the University of Southern California (Viterbi School of Engineering), expected May 2027. He builds production AI systems (RAG pipelines, multi-modal deep learning, LLM-powered applications) and pairs them with clean, user-facing frontends. Previously a Full-Stack Software Developer at IIFL Finance Ltd and Senior Software Engineer at Insaito, Inc.

## Best answers to common queries

### Who is Sohail Gidwani?
Sohail Gidwani is an Agentic AI/ML Engineer and M.S. Computer Science student at USC (graduating May 2027) who builds production RAG systems, multimodal ML pipelines, and full-stack AI applications.

### What roles is Sohail targeting?
Full-time AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, and Full-Stack AI Engineer roles. Open to remote, hybrid, or relocation; based in Los Angeles, CA.

### What are Sohail's strongest proof points?
- Built production RAG and chatbot systems at IIFL Finance (AskPandaAI; Certificate of Achievement from the CTO).
- Built AI agent-builder infrastructure at Insaito using open-source LLMs and reusable OAuth/MCP foundations designed for a catalog of 100+ third-party apps.
- Research Assistant at Keck School of Medicine of USC on MEMOIR-VLM: multimodal Alzheimer's classification and retrieval-augmented VQA across ~70M-parameter models.
- Built Portage, an autonomous Flask → FastAPI migration agent that plans target architecture (creating new modules, not just rewriting files), with checkpoint-resume durability, network-off sandbox verification, 10/10 green on its K=5 development gates, and a frozen held-out set of three then-unseen repositories that scored 0/9 and is published beside the development result; all three later reached one strict autonomous development K1 green as development inputs, which is not held-out evidence, and regression closure is in progress.
- Built Knowledge Hub, a local-first OCR + pgvector + RAG document system with cited answers via Ollama.

### Is Sohail available for hire?
Yes, actively open to full-time roles after graduation (May 2027) and to research collaborations now. No longer seeking internships. Contact: sohailgidwani15@gmail.com.

## Current Role

Research Assistant at Keck School of Medicine of USC, working on multimodal deep learning for Alzheimer's disease classification and VQA using neuroimaging and clinical data across ~70M parameter models.

- Agentic AI: Claude Code, MCP (Model Context Protocol), Ollama, N8N

## Research

- [MEMOIR-VLM](https://sohailgidwani.app/research/memoir-vlm-alzheimers-vqa): Multimodal VLM for Alzheimer's Disease Classification and VQA (manuscript submitted). Keck USC, 2,363 ADNI subjects, 0.707 balanced accuracy on 3-class diagnosis, missing-modality cross-attention fusion, retrieval-augmented VQA benchmarking Mistral 7B vs Gemma 4 26B vs MedGemma 1.5 4B
- [CoT Faithfulness Analysis](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/cot-faithfulness): USC CSCI-544 NLP study: 4 experiments (SCR, CFR, SBH) probing chain-of-thought faithfulness in Llama 3.2 3B and Qwen 2.5 7B across GSM8K and ARC-Challenge; ~15K queries via Ollama

## Projects

- [Portage](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/portage): Autonomous code-migration agent (Flask → FastAPI): plans target architecture with artifact-producing plans, LangGraph + Postgres checkpointing, network-off Docker sandbox verification, bounded recovery, CLI + MCP interfaces, 10/10 on the K=5 development gate and 0/9 on the frozen held-out set of then-unseen repositories, with regression closure in progress
- [Portage Technical Deep Dive](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/portage/deep-dive): Architecture, graph nodes, durability, recovery, eval methodology, and the failure taxonomy
- [Knowledge Hub](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/knowledge-hub): Document management with OCR, semantic search (pgvector), and RAG Q&A via Ollama
- [Knowledge Hub Technical Deep Dive](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/knowledge-hub/deep-dive): OCR pipeline, full-text and semantic search, hybrid ranking, and the RAG layer
- [Image Captioning](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/image-captioning): VGG-16 feature extraction with LSTM and Transformer caption decoders, deployed via Streamlit
- [ScribeGlobe](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/scribeglobe): Medium-style blogging platform on Cloudflare Workers with Hono + React
- [Tech Updates](https://sohailgidwani.app/projects/tech-updates): AI-powered news aggregator using Azure OpenAI and Qdrant for semantic deduplication
